name: Online Friends
source:
ROTTMNT Donnie X Reader Interactive Fanfiction

You've had this online friend, Donnie, for a while now. You two game together, hang out and chat, and just vent when life gets too much.

But even after all this time, he's still worried to actually meet face to face or even just do a video chat. 

What could he be hiding?

[From [url=https://hitechlatte.itch.io/online-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
ROTTMNT Donnie X读者互动同人小说

你认识这位网上朋友唐尼已经有一段时间了。你们两个一起玩游戏、闲逛、聊天，当生活变得太多时发泄一下。

但即使过了这么久，他仍然担心能否真正面对面地见面，甚至只是进行视频聊天。

他还能隐瞒什么？

[来自[url=https://hitechlatte.itch.io/online-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
